`ghql` - a GraphQL client for R

GraphQL - <https://graphql.org>

Examples of GraphQL APIs:

- GitHub:
  <https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/guides/introduction-to-graphql>
- Opentargets:
  <https://genetics-docs.opentargets.org/technical-pipeline/graphql-api>
- Countries GraphQL API: <https://github.com/trevorblades/countries>

Other GraphQL R packages:

- [graphql](https://github.com/ropensci/graphql) - GraphQL query parser
- [gqlr](https://github.com/schloerke/gqlr) - GraphQL server and query
  methods

## Install

CRAN version

``` r

install.packages("ghql")
```

Development version

``` r

remotes::install_github("ropensci/ghql")
```

``` r

library("ghql")
library("jsonlite")
library("dplyr")
```

<https://docs.ropensci.org/ghql/>
